$comment: Tracked production-dependency advisories. scripts/check-audit-gate.mjs fails the build when a high/critical advisory appears that is NOT listed here, when a listed entry passes its `expires` date, or when a listed package picks up a NEW advisory id. Adding an entry is a review decision, not a mute button: every entry needs an owner-visible reason and an expiry date. See docs/security/SECURITY_AUDIT.md § F.

entries.reason: Transitive: webtorrent -> torrent-discovery -> bittorrent-tracker -> ip@2. `ip` is unmaintained upstream and has no patched 2.x. bittorrent-tracker uses ip.isPublic() only to classify peer addresses in tracker responses; Tatakai never relies on it as a trust boundary (the app's own SSRF guard is urlHost.ts / the streaming-proxy isBlockedHost check). Fix path: webtorrent 3 (major, needs a torrent-stack regression pass).
entries.tracking: upgrade webtorrent to 3.x and re-run tests/torrent-*.test.*
